note: Hand-classified from the test source at the pinned Replay SHA. Replay cannot infer where an expected-digest string came from; the independence of PINNED is asserted by the test author (comment in the test file) and is NOT verified by this workflow. Success of any case is a CALLER-TRUSTED CONFIGURATION MATCH, never REGISTRY_AUTHENTICATED.
